entries.name: --gpu
entries.description:
--gpu LIST           run on these GPUs, comma-separated nvidia-smi/PCI indices (default: every
visible one); sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES/CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER inside the engine,
so a caller never has to export environment variables
entries.risk: 路径、生命周期、多卡、诊断或由其他页面管理；此处只读

entries.name: --ple-gguf
entries.description:
--ple-gguf PATH      required PLE table (original second GGUF shard); with --native, the model's
shard that holds per_layer_token_embd.weight when not given
--ple-gguf PATH      the n-gram/PLE shard.  WITHOUT IT LAYER 1's PLE IS SILENTLY SKIPPED,
which changes every number downstream - pass it for any real run
entries.risk: 路径、生命周期、多卡、诊断或由其他页面管理；此处只读

entries.name: --no-ple
entries.description: --no-ple             explicit diagnostic ablation of the PLE layer
entries.risk: 路径、生命周期、多卡、诊断或由其他页面管理；此处只读

entries.name: --ple-io
entries.description:
--ple-io direct|mmap|ram  n-gram table reads (plan v0.3 P2). direct (default): unbuffered SSD
reads, the table never enters RAM or the file cache; mmap: A/B arm;
ram: the whole table locked in RAM at start (VirtualLock on Windows,
mlock elsewhere), so no SSD read sits on the prompt or token path
entries.label: PLE 码表读取方式
entries.risk: 可能大量占用 RAM
entries.hint: direct 直接 SSD 读取；mmap 由 OS 文件缓存管理；ram 把整张约 29GB 码表锁入 RAM。RAM 模式会与专家预算竞争，64GB 机器通常不适合同时保留大专家预算。

entries.name: --ple-row-cache
entries.description: --ple-row-cache N    bounded cache of fetched rows, 90 B each (default 1048576; 0 = off)
entries.label: PLE 行缓存数量
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 缓存已读码表行；帮助给出每行约 90B，默认 1048576。包含索引等实际开销，不是免费内存。

entries.name: --ple-inflight
entries.description: --ple-inflight N     outstanding SSD reads (default 256)
entries.label: PLE 并行读取数量
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 未完成 SSD 读取的数量；增加不保证磁盘更快，可能增加延迟和队列压力。

entries.name: --ple-delay-us
entries.description: --ple-delay-us U     fault injection: each row read completes no earlier than U us
entries.risk: 路径、生命周期、多卡、诊断或由其他页面管理；此处只读

entries.name: --ple-sync-submit
entries.description: --ple-sync-submit    A/B arm: submit table reads on the token thread (default: an I/O thread)
entries.risk: 路径、生命周期、多卡、诊断或由其他页面管理；此处只读

entries.name: --kv
entries.description:
--kv fp16|int8       KV storage (plan v0.3 P7): int8 codes + fp16 scale per 64 values, half the
VRAM; default fp16 until gate G-C accepts int8
--kv q4_0            4-bit K/V after a Hadamard rotation (PR #21): half of int8's memory,
slightly lower precision (see bench/results/2026-09-27-kv-q4)
--kv k8v4            hybrid: INT8 K (exact attention scores) + rotated Q4_0 V, 816 B/cell
(vs int8's 1,056); streams with --kv-resident too
entries.risk: 路径、生命周期、多卡、诊断或由其他页面管理；此处只读

entries.name: --kv-resident
entries.description:
--kv-resident N      KV streaming: keep N cells of each QSA layer in VRAM (min 20480) and the
whole K/V in pinned RAM; the freed VRAM goes to expert slots. 0 (default):
all of it in VRAM. A context of N cells or fewer is not streamed
entries.risk: 路径、生命周期、多卡、诊断或由其他页面管理；此处只读

entries.name: --kv-grow
entries.description:
--kv-grow            the K/V takes VRAM only for the cells the requests reach and the expert
cache holds the rest, giving slots back as the context grows (one GPU, with
--expert-profile; STRATA_KV_GROW=1/0 also). Default: the whole --max-context
allocated at start
entries.label: KV 按实际长度增长
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: on 只为已达到的位置分配 KV，把空余显存暂给专家缓存；随上下文增长归还。只适用单 GPU 和专家 profile；不是扩大总 context。

entries.name: --prompt-cache
entries.description:
--prompt-cache N     --serve: keep N conversation checkpoints between requests (default 6, ~118 MB
of RAM each; 0 = read every prompt from the start)
entries.label: 提示检查点数量
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 在 RAM 中保留提示检查点；0 每次从头读。帮助估计每个约 118 MB，实际随架构和上下文变化。

entries.name: --conversation-cache-mib
entries.description: --conversation-cache-mib N  --serve: RAM budget for parked conversations (default: sized from the free RAM, up to 8192; 0 = off)
entries.label: 停放会话 RAM 预算 (MiB)
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 保存切换出去的会话状态，0 关闭停放。不是模型专家 RAM 预算；与专家、KV、系统共用物理内存。

entries.name: --conversation-cache-slots
entries.description: --conversation-cache-slots N  --serve: at most N parked conversations (default 4)
entries.label: 停放会话数量
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 最多保存多少个停放会话；不增加并发解码数，启动器仍是单路。

entries.name: --conversation-cache-min-free-mib
entries.description:
--conversation-cache-min-free-mib N  --serve: RAM floor (under MemAvailable, the cgroup limits and
--memory-limit-mib) when parking, saving or restoring a session (default 2560)
entries.label: 会话缓存可用 RAM 底线 (MiB)
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 停放、保存、恢复会话时保留的可用 RAM 下限；不是启动器启动前的空闲检查。

entries.name: --memory-limit-mib
entries.description:
--memory-limit-mib N  --serve: the total RAM (MiB) this engine's container or cgroup may use, when
the container cannot see its real limit (also STRATA_MEMORY_LIMIT_MIB; the flag
wins; 0 = none). Parking and session save/restore keep their floor under it
entries.risk: 路径、生命周期、多卡、诊断或由其他页面管理；此处只读

entries.name: --conversation-cache-min-tokens
entries.description:
--conversation-cache-min-tokens N  --serve: park only conversations of at least N tokens, so
short side requests do not take the slots a long one needs (default 0 = park any)
entries.label: 最短可停放会话 (tokens)
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 短于此长度的会话不占停放槽位；0 不限制。

entries.name: --conversation-cache-park-gain
entries.description:
--conversation-cache-park-gain N  --serve: park only after the conversation advanced N tokens past
the copy it would supersede, so a turn that grew by a few hundred tokens does not
write a whole snapshot that the next turn drops (default 0 = park every turn)
entries.label: 会话快照最小增量 (tokens)
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 与旧快照相比至少增长这些 token 才重存；避免每个小回合复制整个长会话。

entries.name: --session-min-free-mib

--batch N / --slots N  --serve (opt-in): up to N requests decode together in batch slots (2..8
normally; --batch-mtp waves more through eight-row windows),
each slot with its own session (VRAM like the main one); docs/BATCHING.md

entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 检查点向历史分散而非只保留最近几个，适合 Agent 改写历史前缀的情况；仍消耗 RAM。

entries.name: --pool-workers
entries.description:
--pool-workers N     R2.2: CPU expert pool worker count.  Default 0 = every physical core

entries.name: --pool-tasks
entries.description:

3 per participating thread; positive counts are capped by row count.
entries.label: CPU 专家任务批数
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 0 为每参与线程约 3 个任务；正值限制每阶段任务数，仍按实际行数截断。太多会增加调度开销。

entries.name: --host-core
entries.description:
--host-core WHERE    The host thread's core: first (the default: the first physical core, as always) or
last (the last physical core, the workers on the others).  Windows sends a GPU's
interrupts to one logical processor, usually the first, and every copy that lands
raises one: a spinning host there waits for them.  Moves threads only, never a
result.  Not on hybrid CPUs.  sibling: the first core's other hardware thread
(SMT), so the interrupts keep the first logical processor and the workers keep
every core; hybrid CPUs too, first without SMT (STRATA_HOST_CORE sets it too).
entries.label: 主线程核心位置
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: first 第一物理核心；last 最后一物理核心；sibling 第一核心的 SMT 兄弟线程。用于避让驱动中断，不增加核心数。last 不适用于混合 P/E 核 CPU。

entries.name: --pool-cores
entries.description:
--pool-cores LIST    Experimental, off by default: pin the CPU workers to exactly these logical
processors (0,2,4,6 or 2-14:2; the numbers Task Manager and lscpu show).  The
default is one worker per physical core, which the start-up line names.  Two
entries on one core, or the host's own, are kept with a warning; processors the
process may not use are left out.  The worker count is the list's length unless
--pool-workers says otherwise.  Moves threads only, never a result.
STRATA_POOL_CORES sets it too.
entries.risk: 路径、生命周期、多卡、诊断或由其他页面管理；此处只读

entries.name: --aux-cpus
entries.description:
--aux-cpus SET       Where the threads that are neither pool workers nor the host thread run (the
adaptive tier's job thread, the prefill helpers, the CUDA driver's threads, ...):
off (the default: wherever they were created), auto (the SMT siblings of the host's
core, then physical cores with no worker; never a CPU that shares a core with a
worker; nothing is done when none is spare) or a CPU list such as 24,26 (Linux; the
host's and the workers' CPUs are dropped from it).  Moves threads only, never a
result.  STRATA_AUX_CPUS sets it too; a request's strata_tune aux_cpus=0|1 beats it.
entries.label: 辅助线程 CPU 分配
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: off 保持创建时分配；auto 尝试放到主线程 SMT 兄弟及没有 worker 的核心。没有空闲核心时不会强行挪动。

entries.name: --pool-affinity
entries.description:
--pool-affinity MODE Worker CPU affinity: all (default: one worker per physical core, as
always), auto (hybrid CPUs: P-cores first, then their SMT siblings,
then E-cores) or p-cores (P-cores and their siblings only).  measure (opt-in,
hybrid CPUs, native packs): all and p-cores are timed on the pack's own experts
at start (about a second) and the faster one is taken
entries.label: CPU 专家线程亲和性
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: all 每物理核心一个 worker；auto 优先 P 核；p-cores 仅 P 核及其 SMT；measure 在启动时做短测再选。9600X 无 P/E 混合结构。

entries.name: --adapt-async
entries.description:
--adapt-async 0|1    --serve with the resident RAM mode or the arena (one GPU): the adaptive
tier's swaps advance between verify windows instead of a window waiting for a
whole round (the arena: copy-in only).  Not bit-exact run to run.  Without the flag,
the expert arena on one CUDA GPU (no --batch) starts blocking and tries it for a
while when the swaps hold the windows up, keeping it only if it is faster; 0 = the
blocking tier always (also STRATA_ADAPT_ASYNC=0); 1 = always on.
entries.label: 异步专家缓存交换
entries.risk: 不可重复路径
entries.hint: 0 始终阻塞式交换；1 在验证窗口之间推进交换。仅适用支持的单 GPU RAM 模式；运行间不保证逐位一致。

entries.name: STRATA_PIN_BY_NEED
entries.description: Pin memory only when needed [exact]
entries.risk: 路径、生命周期、多卡、诊断或由其他页面管理；此处只读

entries.name: STRATA_KVA
entries.description: Reads very long prompts faster by approximating part of the work. Off by default: answers about long documents can miss or mix up details.
entries.label: KVA 长上下文近似加速
entries.risk: 近似计算
entries.hint: on 写入 1；off 写入 0。通过近似部分注意力工作加快长提示，可能漏掉或混淆长文细节。不是 KV 精度 k8v4。

entries.name: STRATA_ROUTE_PRIOR
entries.description: Prefers the parts of the model already on the graphics card, which makes answers faster on 12 GB cards. Off by default: in long agent sessions it can repeat itself and give weaker results. Turn on if you mostly chat and want the speed.
entries.label: 偏向显存中已有专家
entries.risk: 改变路由/质量
entries.hint: off 写入 0；on 写入 1.5，偏向 GPU 已缓存专家以提速，长 Agent 会话可能重复和能力下降。继承不等于关闭；它和 tail skip 完全独立。

entries.name: STRATA_PCIE_FRAC_DEFAULT
entries.description: Shares the work between the graphics card and the processor in a way that makes answers faster on these cards. Turn off to go back to the previous setting, which is slower.
entries.label: PCIe 默认分配规则
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: old 使用旧探测规则，auto 允许运行时按 CPU 成本调整。显式 --pcie-frac 优先。

entries.name: STRATA_VRAM_FREE
entries.description: device 尝试按设备/NVML 空闲量进行预算；具体回退和最终可分配量以启动日志为准。不会绕过 WDDM，也不保证所有空闲显存都能分配。
entries.label: 显存空闲量探测来源
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: device 尝试按设备/NVML 空闲量进行预算；具体回退和最终可分配量以启动日志为准。不会绕过 WDDM，也不保证所有空闲显存都能分配。

entries.name: STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP
entries.description: 0 关闭；1..9 是从零编号的排名门槛，数值越小越激进。仅跳过整个验证窗口都排在门槛之后且未命中 GPU 缓存的专家。7 对应第 8~10 位候选；不是每步固定少算 3 个专家。贡献置零，会改变答案。
entries.label: 尾部专家跳过
entries.risk: 改变模型计算
entries.hint: 0 关闭；1..9 是从零编号的排名门槛，数值越小越激进。仅跳过整个验证窗口都排在门槛之后且未命中 GPU 缓存的专家。7 对应第 8~10 位候选；不是每步固定少算 3 个专家。贡献置零，会改变答案。

entries.name: STRATA_TAIL_SKIP_MAX_CACHED
entries.description: 控制默认 tail skip 的 GPU 专家缓存占比门槛，不是缓存命中率。达到门槛时默认跳过关闭；101 表示不会因占比而关闭。显式 tailSkip 值可覆盖默认判定。
entries.label: 尾部跳过的缓存占比上限 (%)
entries.risk: 改变模型计算
entries.hint: 控制默认 tail skip 的 GPU 专家缓存占比门槛，不是缓存命中率。达到门槛时默认跳过关闭；101 表示不会因占比而关闭。显式 tailSkip 值可覆盖默认判定。

entries.name: STRATA_PREFILL_CPU_SHARE
entries.description: 0 禁用；auto 测量 CPU/GPU 成本后决定；1 显式启用。用于短提示的专家分担，不能保证更快；改变浮点计算路径，近似平局时答案可能变化。
entries.label: 短提示 CPU 专家分担
entries.risk: 计算路径变化
entries.hint: 0 禁用；auto 测量 CPU/GPU 成本后决定；1 显式启用。用于短提示的专家分担，不能保证更快；改变浮点计算路径，近似平局时答案可能变化。

entries.name: --pcie-frac
entries.description: 未命中 GPU 缓存的专家中，多少比例复制到 GPU 计算，其余由 CPU 原地计算。不是 GPU 利用率。增大可能减少 CPU 压力，也可能堵塞 PCIe。显式数值覆盖自动分配。
entries.label: 未命中专家的 PCIe 份额
entries.risk: 计算路径变化
entries.hint: 未命中 GPU 缓存的专家中，多少比例复制到 GPU 计算，其余由 CPU 原地计算。不是 GPU 利用率。增大可能减少 CPU 压力，也可能堵塞 PCIe。显式数值覆盖自动分配。

entries.name: STRATA_PCIE_K_RULE
entries.description: 0 回到旧 K 规则；1 允许按 CPU 吞吐调整 K。仅自动 PCIe 分配路径使用。
entries.label: PCIe 自适应 K 规则
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 0 回到旧 K 规则；1 允许按 CPU 吞吐调整 K。仅自动 PCIe 分配路径使用。

entries.name: STRATA_PCIE_SHARE_MAX
entries.description: 限制自动规则的最大复制份额；不能替代总线带宽。显式 --pcie-frac 时不生效。
entries.label: 自动 PCIe 份额上限
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 限制自动规则的最大复制份额；不能替代总线带宽。显式 --pcie-frac 时不生效。

entries.name: --adapt-every
entries.description: 每多少次验证窗口更新专家缓存；0 关闭自适应，与路由学习不兼容。不是保存学习表的分钟数。
entries.label: 专家缓存适应间隔
entries.risk: 缓存位置变化
entries.hint: 每多少次验证窗口更新专家缓存；0 关闭自适应，与路由学习不兼容。不是保存学习表的分钟数。

entries.name: --adapt-swaps
entries.description: 越多越快追随新话题，也增加复制和适应成本；0 不交换，与路由学习不兼容。
entries.label: 每轮专家交换数
entries.risk: 缓存位置变化
entries.hint: 越多越快追随新话题，也增加复制和适应成本；0 不交换，与路由学习不兼容。

entries.name: --adapt-decay
entries.description: 越小越快忘记旧话题；1 不衰减。不是温度或重复惩罚。
entries.label: 专家热度衰减
entries.risk: 缓存位置变化
entries.hint: 越小越快忘记旧话题；1 不衰减。不是温度或重复惩罚。

entries.name: STRATA_ADAPT_OVERLAP
entries.description: 在整个专家 arena 驻留 RAM 的单 GPU 路径，让复制与后续窗口重叠；不等同于 --adapt-async，不能和 async、pipeline、lag/nowait 等模式混用。
entries.label: 专家复制与窗口重叠
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 在整个专家 arena 驻留 RAM 的单 GPU 路径，让复制与后续窗口重叠；不等同于 --adapt-async，不能和 async、pipeline、lag/nowait 等模式混用。

entries.name: STRATA_PLE_AUTO_MMAP
entries.description: 1 恢复启动探测发现 direct 慢时转 mmap 的规则；0 禁止自动转换。是否真的转换以日志为准。
entries.label: 慢直接读取自动转 mmap
entries.risk: 资源/性能
entries.hint: 1 恢复启动探测发现 direct 慢时转 mmap 的规则；0 禁止自动转换。是否真的转换以日志为准。
